items.title: Production fix: thread metadataRoot through captureReviewRunSnapshot + diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot
items.context: handlers/review-run.ts:102 passes signedWorkspaceRoot only. Add a metadataRoot param to captureReviewRunSnapshot AND diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot (core/review-run.ts:310,265) and pass workspace.metadataRoot || ctx.root so run.materialHash/storyFilesHash + workspaceBinding sign with the storyDir-aware exclusion set. Default metadataRoot=projectRoot keeps plain repos byte-identical. Spike caveat: diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot only uses it for the EMPTY_MATERIAL_HASH diagnostic but thread it for consistency.
